text:
kai: heads up — sudden GPU attach failures in us-west2 starting ~07:12 UTC. Ops alert shows ~50 failures in 5m. Correlates with scratchpool NVMe IOPS spikes.

ops-bot: ALERT: gpu-attach-failures us-west2 count=50 window=5m severity=high link=https://grafana/redwood/alerts/9999 :rotating_light:

dana: dash check — scratchpool IOPS jumped 2k->22k at 07:12 with small-write burst signature. Janitor pods show many concurrent sweeps (concurrency=12).

maria: SMARTs show temp rising (194->205) and media retries. Attach latency climbs, retries increase.

ajay: likely backscatter from janitor/scrub concurrency colliding with attach waves. Short-term: throttle janitor concurrency and add attach fallback to warm pool. Proposed canary patch: janitor.rate_limit_qps=6, max_concurrency=2, backoff_ms=250. Also attach CB route when attach >400ms.

kai: patched canary 5 nodes at 07:28 with rate_limit_qps=6. Attach failures dropped 50->4 over 10m. Median attach latency 700ms->180ms.

dana: good. Recommend regional dynamic policy: sample local IOPS and temp, schedule heavy scrubs off-peak (propose us-west2 scrubs to 03:00 UTC).

maria: host log (gnode-42) 07:12: "[07:12:11] janitor: start sweep /scratch/tmp (concurrency=12)
[07:12:14] nvme: iops burst=22000 qdepth=512
[07:12:45] gpu-attacher: attach timeout retry=1 host=gnode-42" — clear backscatter.

ajay: actions: 1) regional throttle us-west2 24h; 2) enable attach fallback to warm pool; 3) add probe: if scratchpool_iops>10k && attach_failures>5/5m -> runbook. Creating ticket INFRA-16233.

kai: enabling fallback canary now. Warm-pool absorbs load with small cost bump, avoided customer impact.

dana: follow-ups: change janitor heuristics (scale by observed iops not free-space), add backscatter_index = scrub_rw_bytes/attach_ops metric, alert when >0.8 + SMART temp>200.

ajay: INFRA-16233 created and assigned to kai/dana/maria. Staged rollout 10%->50%->100% over 2h.

ops-bot: ACTION_CREATED INFRA-16233 https://redwood/infra/tickets/16233 created by ajay assigned=[kai,dana,maria] priority=P1

kai: tl;dr — throttle + fallback fixed immediate issue; next: telemetry + default heuristics change; will post postmortem after soak. :thumbsup:

maria: cost note — warm-pool fallback ~+4% monthly for impacted tenants during window, acceptable trade-off.

dana: scheduling controlled soak tomorrow 02:00 UTC, invite platform team and oncall.

ajay: runbook tasks assigned. Ping #eng-oncall if regressions and cc @kai.

(reactions: :white_check_mark: :wrench:)
